key_insight: ElasticTTT fixes test-time tuning for video editing by preserving the pretrained diffusion prior, preventing collapse back to the source video or feature entanglement.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical way to adapt pretrained video diffusion models at inference time while maintaining editability, spatial consistency, and stronger one-shot editing results.
method: Target Distribution Regularization: avoids sharp memorization minima during tuning.
Contrastive CFG: steers generation away from source-video biases.
Asynchronous Noise Schedule: protects unedited regions during editing.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive evaluations and theoretical analysis showing state-of-the-art performance on one-shot video editing while preserving the base model prior.
watch_item: The method adds inference-time tuning complexity, so stability and hyperparameter sensitivity may be important in real deployments.
paper_title: ElasticTTT: Prior-Preserving Test-Time Tuning for Video Editing
